subject: Quick check: latency notes & next steps for Zenith AI
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenith.ai>, Chris Lopez <chris.lopez@zenith.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: call recap + latency numbers (Zenith AI)

Hi Alex / Chris —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for carving out time. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

What we covered
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for your reranking pipeline while keeping cost within target.
- Top technical asks you raised: p99 at 512 tokens, expected throughput for 10k r/s load, and whether KV-cache warming will help the burst pattern you described.

What I’m sending (attached)
- bench_config.json: the minimal config we used to reproduce the baseline numbers you asked about.
- zenith_latency_report_v1.pdf: initial readout from our internal run with a model variant comparable to your stack (quantized). Contains p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU breakdown, and batching settings.

Suggested next steps
1) If the attached readout looks sensible, we can schedule a short POC: 1 day to run your sample prompt set on a dedicated runner (we’ll handle data isolation).
2) If POC looks good, we’ll produce a mutual action plan and a short pricing estimate for Dedicated capacity.

Can you confirm if you want us to run the POC (we’ll need a sample prompt set and an S3 bucket or an upload link)? If timeline shifted on your side, tell me the new priority and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll hold a slot next week for a POC if you’re interested.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: zenith_latency_report_v1.pdf (PDF), bench_config.json (JSON)
From: Chris Lopez <chris.lopez@zenith.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenith.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: call recap + latency numbers (Zenith AI)

Hey Priyom —

Thanks for the tidy recap and the files. A few quick answers from our infra side:
- p99 (512 tokens): ~140ms on our current infra with the model shard layout we discussed. We saw p95 ~85ms.
- Throughput: to sustain ~10k r/s we’d want to target batching + sharding; looks like Redwood’s continuous batching approach could help but we’d want to validate with our prompt distribution.
- KV-cache: our access pattern has a high prefix overlap for 60% of requests — caching should materially reduce effective latency for those subsets.

I attached a short internal readout (zenith_latency_report_v1.pdf) with our test harness results and the sample prompt set we used. I didn’t run a full Redwood POC yet — we’re still aligning internally on the priority.

If you can run the POC against our sample prompt set (I attached it inside the PDF), that’d be ideal. If cost or timeline is an issue, let us know approximate pricing for a 1-day dedicated run and what isolation guarantees you offer.

Cheers,
Chris Lopez
Head of ML Infrastructure
Zenith AI

Attachment stubs: zenith_latency_report_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenith.ai>, Chris Lopez <chris.lopez@zenith.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: call recap + latency numbers (Zenith AI)

Priyom / Aditya —

Quick internal note to align on approach before we push the POC ask externally again:
- Pricing: for a 1-day dedicated run (GPU-backed, single tenant) we should estimate $2,500–3,500 depending on model size; include a short bullet that it covers data separation and transient logs only.
- Scope: run the attached bench_config.json + their prompt set, capture p50/p95/p99 and token cost delta with/without KV-cache.
- Ops: ask if they want the run inside Redwood Dedicated (reserved) or as a one-off hosted job — that will determine SLA and billing flow.

I can draft the short pricing note and the POC statement of work if you want. Priyom — want me to send that directly to Chris/ Alex or should we wait until they confirm priority?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — POC offer & cost estimate (Zenith AI)

Hi Alex / Chris —

Just wanted to follow up on the note below. Chris — thanks again for the readout on p99/throughput and for sharing the prompt set. I know you were aligning internally on priority last week — I wanted to check whether that’s shifted and whether you’d like us to schedule the 1-day POC.

Quick reminder of what we can do immediately
- 1-day dedicated run using your prompt set (Redwood will provide single-tenant isolation and delete logs after handoff).
- Deliverable: p50/p95/p99 numbers, token cost delta, and recommendations on batching/KV-cache settings.
- Ballpark cost: $2,750 for a single run (covers compute + isolation + short report). We can absorb up to 25% credit for first-time POCs if budget is a blocker.

If the priority has shifted, no problem — a quick reply with timing (e.g., “low / medium / high” for next 90 days) would help us plan. If you prefer, I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff to lock in the scope.
